card.text: Explore Wild 2's observed Stardust terrain, preserving its real coverage gaps.

introduction.text: Stardust flew past Wild 2 in 2004 and returned samples of its dust to Earth. Its photographs reveal deep depressions, steep walls and ridges across the sunlit part of the nucleus.

model.title: Nucleus shape reconstruction
model.summary: Measured terrain covers about half the nucleus. The gray grid marks the fitted ellipsoid and joins used to complete the unseen side. Gray is a model material.

navcam.title: NavCam mosaic
navcam.summary: Only the measured side is photographed. Original shadows and some seams remain; the gray grid marks gaps in the coverage.
